name: Can smart home technology be integrated during a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can smart home technology be integrated during a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whole-home renovations are an ideal time to add smart thermostats, lighting controls, security systems, and structured wiring, since walls are open and access to systems is easier.
